up: Retrieve all approved drugs (max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary) that have an indication for multiple myeloma in the drug_indication table. Return the drug's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), name (pref_name), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), and all indication details (mesh_heading, efo_term, max_phase_for_ind). Filter drug_indication where mesh_heading = 'Multiple Myeloma' OR efo_term = 'multiple myeloma'. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno, and with compound_structures on molregno. sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading = 'Multiple Myeloma' OR di.efo_term = 'multiple myeloma');
